author: Mark Atwood
text:
Cascade from PKIX-fmtv.17's rescope decision (Mark, 2026-05-12, attended):

This bead's deliverable is now well-defined. Blocks on:
- **PKIX-fmtv.22** — TLS hostname corpus (consumed for `-purpose sslserver` differential and eventually `-purpose sslclient`)
- **PKIX-fmtv.23** — S/MIME mailbox corpus (consumed for `-purpose smimesign` differential)

Code-signing (`-purpose codesign`) and OCSP-helper (`-purpose ocsphelper`) wrappers don't need a curated corpus — the wrapper acceptance is "EKU enforced; chain rejection without the right EKU". A handful of targeted unit-test diffs against OpenSSL is sufficient.

**Scope clarification:**
- TLS server differential: full corpus through both verify_tls_server and `openssl verify -purpose sslserver -verify_hostname X`. Compare verdicts; document disagreements.
- TLS client differential: same corpus through verify_tls_client_dns (once PKIX-fmtv.11.2 client half ships) and `openssl verify -purpose sslclient -verify_hostname X` (sslclient also accepts hostname). Document semantic differences.
- S/MIME signer differential: mailbox corpus through verify_smime_signer and `openssl verify -purpose smimesign -verify_email X`.
- S/MIME recipient differential: same corpus through verify_smime_recipient and `openssl verify -purpose smimeencrypt -verify_email X` (note: smimeencrypt is the encryption-purpose; verify_smime_recipient corresponds to it).
- Code signing: small unit-test diff vs `openssl verify -purpose codesign` on the existing code-signing fixtures.
- Time stamping: same — small unit-test diff vs `openssl verify -purpose timestampsign`.
- OCSP helper: small unit-test diff vs `openssl verify -purpose ocsphelper` against the OCSP responder fixtures (once PKIX-fmtv.13.3 fixtures land).

Acceptance: per-purpose pass-rate documented in pkix-difftest/baseline-verify-openssl.md. Disagreements either resolved or documented (legitimate semantic divergence — e.g. OpenSSL legacy behavior we don't replicate).

Releasing stale claim, removing human label — decision is settled, implementation is mechanical once .22 / .23 ship.
